title_zh: 先问清废土去向再开始挖花坛

scenario.label_zh: 核实花坛挖土与废土去向
scenario.goal_zh: 先向负责人确认土堆用途和处置方式再开始挖土

context_zh: 社区花园志愿者准备整理花坛，先核对土堆用途与去向。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Shall I dig out the old flower bed while you move the pots?

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: Not yet. Where were you planning to put the soil?

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: I thought I could dump it on that pile behind the shed.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: That pile belongs to the school project. We don't know whether they want this soil mixed into it.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Good point. I'll ask the garden coordinator where the old soil should go.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: Thanks. We can move the empty pots while we wait for an answer.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Agreed. No digging until we've checked the disposal plan.
